decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 4 - The proposal is for a single storey addition at the rear of the existing property not visible from public view and is considered to complement the existing built form with regard to position, bulk, scale, materials and appearance and would not result in any significant adverse impacts upon the amenity of the existing site, adjoining and neighbouring properties or integrity of the Conservation Area. The development is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, adopted December 2003.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the house
